newsitem.title: UK: Whitbread buys five children's nurseries.
newsitem.headline: Whitbread buys five children's nurseries.

text.p: British food, drinks and leisure company Whitbread Plc said on Wednesday it bought five children's nurseries from independent operator Busy Bees for two million pounds.
Whitbread said the five nurseries will be operated by Gatehouse Nursery Services, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Whitbread's David Lloyd Leisure business.
It said the deal makes David Lloyd Leisure the largest operator of privately-owned nurseries in Britain with 24 sites.

The company said it expected to continue opening around three nurseries a year. It said the market was worth around 1.34 billion pounds and the number of private day-care nurseries had doubled to around 5,000 in the last five years.
